title: Agent Workbench: Why Capable Models Still Fail — The Missing Environment
titleKn: Agent Workbench: ಸಮರ್ಥ ಮಾದರಿಗಳೂ ಏಕೆ ವಿಫಲ — ಕಾಣೆಯಾದ ಪರಿಸರ
desc: Why strong models still fail real repository tasks: they lack the context, guardrails and feedback a good working environment supplies.
objectives: Explain that capability and reliability are different things.
List what a workbench supplies around the model.
Diagnose failures as environment problems, not only model problems.
objectivesKn: ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ ಬೇರೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.
workbench ಮಾದರಿಯ ಸುತ್ತ ಏನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.

title: Agent Workbench: Why Capable Models Still Fail — Common Failure Patterns in Repositories
titleKn: Agent Workbench — ರೆಪೊಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವೈಫಲ್ಯ ಮಾದರಿಗಳು
desc: Recurring ways coding agents fail in real repositories and the environmental fix for each.
objectives: Recognise scope creep, false completion, context loss and convention drift.
Match each to a workbench remedy.
Instrument failures so they can be counted.
objectivesKn: scope creep, ಸುಳ್ಳು ಪೂರ್ಣತೆ, context ನಷ್ಟ, ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.

title: Agent Workbench: Why Capable Models Still Fail — Measuring the Workbench
desc: How to measure whether workbench changes improve outcomes, using task suites, ablations and cost tracking.
objectives: Build a small task suite representative of your repository.
Run ablations: remove one workbench element at a time.
Track success, retries and human corrections.
objectivesKn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ರೆಪೊದ ಪ್ರತಿನಿಧಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಸೂಟ್ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿ.
